root_cause: The modal's click listener uses `event.target.closest('[data-micromodal-close]')`, so any click inside the modal that bubbles up to the overlay (which has the close trigger) closes the modal. Pressing Space on a checkbox generates a click event that bubbles to the overlay, causing the dialog to close unexpectedly.
repair_strategy: Modify the click handler to only close the modal when the target element itself has the `[data-micromodal-close]` attribute, preventing clicks on inner content (like checkboxes) from triggering a close while preserving the ability to close via the overlay.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Space on the weekly digest checkbox will toggle its state without closing the preferences dialog, keeping the dialog open and focus retained inside the modal.
functional_risks: If any inner element incorrectly carries the data-micromodal-close attribute, it will no longer close the modal (but such usage is unlikely).
Ensure that the overlay still receives clicks and closes the modal as expected.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Space on the #weekly checkbox checks it and the modal remains open (aria-hidden false).
Confirm that clicking the modal overlay still closes the modal.
Ensure Escape key continues to close the modal.
Check that Tab key trapping within the modal still functions.
